notes.title: Frigato Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello fellow gamers[/h3]

We just want you to know that our friends from Mercat Games just launched the first pirate real-time tactics strategy game [b]Frigato: Shadows of the Caribbean[/b] on Steam. 

If you want to check how the game looks, here is the latest trailer [previewyoutube=H923FwBbH-0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]You can grab the game when it's 15% off![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1667750/Frigato_Shadows_of_the_Caribbean/

Here you can relax with Pirates of the Caribbean vibes, listening to Frigato Soundtrack
[previewyoutube=R9xkJ7GHQ10;full][/previewyoutube]

And lastly, here you can watch developers as pirates🏴‍☠️ 

If you want to talk with us, share your opinion, speak with the community, send feedback, or just goof around. Jump on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9VxNnCHnGY]discord[/url] We are waiting!

Have a great time playing,
